study type: Cross-sectional study with in vitro experimental validation
cohort: Human placenta samples were obtained at term Caesarean section from lean and obese pregnant women for initial analysis and subsequent in vitro experiments.
finding: Total Ras protein expression and combined K-Ras and H-Ras activity were significantly increased in placentas of obese pregnant women, and K-Ras silencing (but not H-Ras) significantly suppressed induced IL-6, IL-8, and MCP-1 expression and secretion and reduced downstream ERK-1/2 activation.
